name: Horned Toad
flavour: Sits like a rock. Bites like one too.
art_prompt: a fat grumpy horned toad lizard covered in short blunt spikes, sandy brown with dark blotches and a pale belly, squat on four stubby legs, a wide flat head with a frowning mouth and a crown of horns, standing on the ground
motion: waddling in place on short stubby legs, slow and heavy, belly swaying
doc: Armoured and slow; three armor takes a pea to five. Two seconds after it dies the body bursts in a red ring, so standing on a kill is a habit it breaks.
